text: You have thousands of photos of your dog. coco turns each real moment into a card, and grows your pet's AI only from those cards.
Open the app, and Coco is there, with today's pack waiting.
Every card keeps one moment that really happened. Tilt it, and the light moves.
Ask if she can wait in the car while you grab coffee. She checks today's weather first, and gently says no.
And she shows you why, with the source.
coco. A co-world for you and your pet.
